item.content:encoded:
"The Scarlet King was bucking his seal, and attempting to push back against Ruslav, and Adebayo."

Well… Shit.

In all seriousness, though, I think I'm going to like this. My favorite version of the Scarlet Bastard is the one in Dust and Blood, an unstoppable, eldritch terror born from the Library, seeking only to end all that is. Having him being semi-contained by the Foundation through the use of alchemy definitely fits in that narrative. Great work, +1

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
Should have reserved this…

Special thanks go out to NineVolt, DrShaw, DrBleep, Lex1nat0r, Pedantique, Lily, Eris, and a dozen others who read some form of this, as well as my girlfriend Janelle for pushing me to pursue this.

This is part 1 of 5, of what's going to be the Alchemy Division series. This is also leading up to a 001 proposal involving the O5 council, the Alchemists, and the origins of the Foundation itself.

Stay Tuned!
